==================================================
1. IMPLEMENT THE FULL 8-ITEM CHAT LOADING FIX
==================================================

Complete the actual runtime fixes identified by the diagnostic engine.

Required:

1. Cached shell
2. Skeleton placeholders
3. Parallel startup requests
4. Bounded timeouts
5. Background message hydration
6. Non-blocking AI health check
7. Non-blocking worker status check
8. Clear retry/error fallback

Do not stop after diagnosis.

==================================================
2. FIX THE CONFIRMED ROOT CAUSE
==================================================

The confirmed root cause is diagnostic requests being misrouted through the senior-developer build-request path.

Fix the routing so:

- diagnostic requests go to diagnostic engine
- status requests go to task-status output
- code-change requests go to approval/execution
- deployment requests go to deploy workflow
- explanation requests return explanation only

No diagnostic request may create a fake COMMITTING stage before a real diff exists.

==================================================
3. COMPLETE CHAT PERFORMANCE FIXES
==================================================

Implement:

- recent messages first
- cursor pagination
- lazy attachment loading
- one realtime subscription per conversation
- cached session restore
- no repeated owner lookup
- no repeated AI readiness probe
- no full-history fetch on first paint
- bounded API timeout
- retry button
- visible offline state
- no blank screen
- no infinite spinner

==================================================

==================================================

- cold start
- warm start
- route mount
- session restore
- owner lookup
- conversation lookup
- first message paint
- composer ready
- realtime connected
- full interaction ready

Return actual milliseconds.

Required targets:

- chat shell visible immediately
- first useful content under 2 seconds on normal network
- no indefinite loading
- optional service failures do not block chat

==================================================
